positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
I served as a software engineer at Reyna Technology Services, LLC (Reyna ITS) for over 7 years. Reyna ITS is a woman-minority owned company which offers cloud solutions and cloud centric services partnered with and leveraging the two world leading cloud brands and platforms, these being Microsoft and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The company serves primarily the Small Medium Business market (SMB), but also works with the enterprise market including both the public and private sectors, upholding their mission to serve a wide range of organizations.

As a Software Engineer for Reyna ITS, I worked with various clients in an innovative professional service company. Working with these organizations required me to handle multiple different projects simultaneously. My responsibilities for such projects include web form, module, and class development, testing and deployment in various client environments, writing user-defined functions and Stored Procedures in SQL Server, in addition to SSRS reports and using an internal framework for data retrieval, security and authorization as the basis of the application. Both my multitude of other work experiences and my position at Reyna ITS also involve fluency in Visual Basic .NET, working with different frameworks, databases, and webservers.

positions.title: IT MES Analyst
positions.description: I fulfilled the position as software developer for the Manufacturing Executions Systems IT department, which is responsible in designing, developing and implementing software solutions for the manufacturing processes of the business, as well as other key areas such as Finances, Quality, and Materials Planning. I worked specifically on a multitude of projects, including the Reel Verification System, which verifies correct component reel placement in SMT pick-and-place machines by validating part number, lot number and intensity value, depending on the setup for the product in process. Duties included full responsibility for the software development cycle, interacting with the Engineering, Manufacturing Process, and Materials departments, designing the database scheme, developing client modules installed in every line and used by operators and technicians, developing the web administration portal, as well as system testing.
